purpose: Prioritize actual REI Bianchi IGM coupled histories; never replace the immutable central DAG or grant physical admission.

observed_sources.note: The central snapshot is a dated immutable reference, not a claim of latest merged canonical status. GitHub main and October unmerged branches have distinct histories.

primary_science.first_falsifiable_product: For one locked S0 source realization and matching initial/boundary data, compare FLRW versus selected Bianchi backgrounds along an accepted coupled interval, with x_HII(z), T(z), photon/energy/work ledger and declared uncertainty.
primary_science.longer_term: Complete source-qualified reionization history and geometry/cosmological perturbation or LoS observables only when relevant owner interfaces and numerical gates are actually established.
primary_science.claim_limit: No independent EoR prediction, no complete all-11 Bianchi result, no production or L4 activation.

nodes.completion_test: Actual immutable packet plus named REI consumer and a concrete parity/ledger check, or explicit missing field. A prose mapping alone does not close this bridge.

nodes.completion_test: Coverage must be calculated against all 313 physical obligations; reference rows or 10,016 containments alone are not physical acceptance.

nodes.gate: No 0/313 promotion from a symbolic or source-conditional surrogate.

nodes.completion_test: A full accepted interval, not a microstep, frozen RHS, population table or source moment alone.

nodes.completion_test: Exact source/clock/energy mapping and independent observable check, with no claimed all-type sweep unless executed.

interpretation.dependency_semantics: Only requires[] is a hard dependency. A conditional owner is not silently a universal prerequisite.
interpretation.selection_rule: Select the next task on the shortest valid path to a physically interpretable paired REI history, not by row count, PR count or R/C stage count. Do not auto-execute.
